pattern.crimePattern: songwriter kills the producer who released her song under another name
pattern.notes: Fictional studio, artists and song. The concert venue is named only as "the Kasarani show"; no real event or performer is depicted.

ob.text: Clinton Mbaabu, a musician, reports that music producer Shadrack "Shaddy B" Wekulo (25) was found dead in his studio, Mtaa Records, Dandora Phase 4, at 00:05, when Clinton arrived for a midnight recording session.

people.name: Shadrack "Shaddy B" Wekulo
people.bio: Built a studio in his mother's old ground-floor flat. Half of Dandora has recorded there; most of them say he owes them something.

image.brief: Kenyan young man, mid 20s, bucket hat, oversized studio headphones around his neck, a thin gold chain, a cocky half-smile, ID-photo framing

people.name: Mercyline Jepkosgei
people.bio: Shaddy's girlfriend and co-writer. Last week he released her song, Moto wa Jioni, credited to another artist, with her listed as "backing vocals".

image.brief: Kenyan young woman, mid 20s, a cropped silver stage jacket, long braids, stage make-up a little smudged, ONE gold hoop earring in her RIGHT ear only, LEFT ear clearly bare, defiant and frightened, ID-photo framing, face turned slightly so both ears are visible

people.name: Clinton Mbaabu
people.bio: Rival MC. Shaddy owed him three paid sessions he never gave him. Found the body.

image.brief: Kenyan young man, late 20s, durag under a cap, a hoodie with a hand-painted crew name, a notebook of lyrics in his hand, shaken, ID-photo framing

people.name: Rosemary Nyambura
people.bio: Manages four young artists. Shaddy owed her a performance fee from April.

image.brief: Kenyan woman, late 30s, a lanyard with an ALL ACCESS pass, a clipboard and two phones, sharp blazer over a T-shirt, exhausted, ID-photo framing

people.name: Sophie Adongo
people.bio: Lives above the studio. Has complained about the bass every weekend for two years.

image.brief: Kenyan woman, early 40s, short relaxed hair, a dressing-gown over a T-shirt, reading glasses, irritable and tired, ID-photo framing

people.name: Erastus Mugo
people.bio: Rides nights from the Kariobangi base.

image.brief: Kenyan man, early 30s, a padded boda rider's jacket with reflective strips, a helmet under his arm, a cheerful gap-toothed face gone serious, ID-photo framing

locations.name: Mtaa Records, Dandora Phase 4
locations.description: A one-room studio in a converted ground-floor flat. Egg trays glued over every wall for soundproofing. A mixing desk, two speakers, a wardrobe turned into a vocal booth. A booking clipboard by the door. A concert poster on the outside of the door.

hotspots.label: By the mixing desk
hotspots.text: Shaddy lies by the mixing desk. A heavy microphone stand is on the floor beside him.

hotspots.label: Under the mixing desk
hotspots.text: Something small and gold glints under the desk, against the wall.

hotspots.label: Booking clipboard
hotspots.text: Tonight's sessions, written in by the artists themselves.

hotspots.label: Poster on the door
hotspots.text: A poster for tonight's big show at Kasarani: a line-up with times, and a photo of each act.

hotspots.label: Desk drawer
hotspots.text: A drawer of loose papers: contracts, receipts, handwritten lyrics.

hotspots.label: Stairs up
hotspots.text: Sophie Adongo is sitting on the stairs in her dressing gown. "I told him the bass would kill somebody one day. I didn't mean this."

evidence.title: Amani's note: Mercyline at the studio door

evidence.noPhoto: Amani's own written observation of a person: it stays the note.

facts.text: Clinton Mbaabu found producer Shadrack "Shaddy B" Wekulo dead in Mtaa Records at 00:05.
Shaddy was struck with a heavy microphone stand.
A single gold hoop earring, clasp bent open, was lying under the mixing desk.
Booking clipboard: '23:00 — MERCY — vocal retake', initialled 'MJ' with a small heart.
Booking clipboard: '00:00 — CLINTON — midnight session'.
Kasarani show poster: Mercyline's slot was 21:00–21:20.
The poster photo shows Mercyline on stage in a silver jacket.
Draft lyrics of Moto wa Jioni in Mercyline's handwriting, with the same small hearts.
Sophie: shouting from the studio from about 23:15, a man and a woman. A crash at about 23:30.
Sophie: from her window, right after the crash, she saw a woman in a silver jacket run to a boda at the corner.
Sophie stayed upstairs and only came down when the police arrived.
Mercyline is wearing one gold hoop, in her right ear. Her left ear is bare.
Mercyline: "I was at the Kasarani show until midnight. Ask my manager, Rosemary."
Mercyline: "Shaddy stole my song. I wanted my name on it, not his blood."
Mercyline admits she went to the studio after her set and signed in for 23:00. They fought about the song. She says she left before half past eleven and he was alive.
Clinton: "I came for my midnight session and found him. Ask my rider."
Erastus: Clinton was at the Kariobangi boda base playing pool from about 22:30. Erastus rode him to the studio at 23:50 and dropped him at 00:05.
Rosemary: "I was paying performers at Kasarani until after midnight."
Rosemary: Mercyline left the show straight after her set, crying.
Kasarani organiser's payment sheet: Rosemary signed for performer payouts at 22:40, 23:25 and 00:10.

interrogations.intro: Mercyline arrives at 01:10 with her silver jacket over her arm. She keeps touching her ear. "Shaddy? Who did this to him?"

topics.reply: That is my song. My words, my melody. He put another man's name on it and called me backing vocals.
Gold hoops? Every manzi in Nairobi has gold hoops.
Silver is in this year. Go to any show.

interrogations.intro: Clinton sits on the kerb outside the studio with his lyric book on his knees. "I came to record. That's all. I came to record."

topics.reply: He took everyone's money. Not everyone's songs. Mine he just never recorded.
Erastus brought me. Call him. We left Kariobangi ten to twelve.

interrogations.intro: Rosemary answers on the third ring, a crowd still roaring behind her. "Mtaa Records? What happened?"

topics.reply: Mercy? She left straight after her set. She was crying. I thought it was nerves.
He owed me forty thousand from April. You don't kill a man you're waiting to get paid by.

interrogations.intro: Sophie pulls her dressing gown tighter. "Two years of bass through my floor. Tonight it was shouting instead."

topics.reply: His girlfriend. The singer. She is here more than he is.

contradictions.reaction: I went to the studio after my set. Fine. I signed in for a retake so he would have to see me. We fought about the song. I left before half eleven. He was alive. He was laughing at me.

prosecutor.pass: Her name on the clipboard, her jacket at the corner, and her other earring under his desk. That will hold.
fail: Doesn't hold up. The man who found him arrived after the crash. Who was there when it happened?
No. Look at the earring. Then look at everyone's ears.

proof.concludes: Mercyline's set ended at 21:20 and she signed in at the studio for 23:00. She was not at Kasarani until midnight; pressed, she admits being at the studio.
A man and a woman were shouting from 23:15. After the crash at 23:30 a woman in a silver jacket ran to a boda. Mercyline performed in a silver jacket tonight.
One gold hoop is under the desk, and Mercyline arrived wearing only one, in her right ear. He had stolen her song. Mercyline Jepkosgei killed Shaddy.

eliminations.why: Clinton was playing pool at the Kariobangi boda base until 23:50 and reached the studio at 00:05, after the crash.
Rosemary was signing for performer payouts at Kasarani at 22:40, 23:25 and 00:10.
Sophie stayed in her flat upstairs until the police came.
Erastus was at the Kariobangi base with Clinton until they rode out at 23:50.

reconstruction.text: Last week. Moto wa Jioni goes out under another artist's name. Mercyline, who wrote every word, is "backing vocals".
21:20. Her set at Kasarani ends. She leaves in her silver stage jacket, crying, and takes a boda across town.
23:00. She signs the studio clipboard for a "vocal retake", with the little heart she always draws, so he will have to see her.
She asks for her name on the song. He tells her she is lucky to be on it at all. At 23:30 she swings the mic stand. In the struggle her left earring falls and rolls under the desk.
She runs to a boda at the corner. Upstairs, Sophie sees a silver jacket go past under the streetlight.

tier1.line: Artists sign the clipboard themselves. Read who came at eleven, and how she signs her name.

tier2.line: One earring under the desk. Now look closely at everyone who walks through that door.

glossary.def: A Kenyan street-music genre, born in the estates of Nairobi.
Neighbourhood; the estate. "Studio ya mtaa": the neighbourhood studio.
Short for boda-boda: a motorbike taxi.

ui.beatNotes: Portraits are evidence: first case where a detail in a person's image (one earring) is a fact. The portrait zoom view becomes a hotspot. Image requirement: Mercyline's portrait must show one gold hoop in the RIGHT ear and a bare LEFT ear; this image is checked by hand before shipping, because the deduction depends on it.
